options.D: legislators have to proceed on a recess

records.year_provenance: Dated older source, full question recovery
records.source_excerpt:
1. Delegated legislation becomes unavoidable when
A. legislators cannot reach a consensus
B. issues under consideration are personal
C. issues under consideration are technical
D. legislators have to proceed on a recess
records.hold_reason: Technical complexity is a reason to delegate lawmaking, but the source says delegation becomes unavoidable. Recess may also require delegated action, and the categorical claim is not uniquely supported.

original_record.subject: government
original_record.question: One major disadvantage of public opinion is that

options.A: the critics of government policies are always harassed
options.B: a vocal minority claims to represent the majority

records.year_provenance: Dated older source, full question recovery
records.source_excerpt:
2. One major disadvantage of public opinion is that
A. the critics of government policies are always
harassed B. a vocal minority
claims to represent the majority
C. gossip and rumours thrive
D. leaders are unnecessarilly criticized
records.hold_reason: A vocal minority claiming to represent all views and the spread of rumours can both be weaknesses of public-opinion processes. The source does not establish one uniquely major disadvantage.

original_record.question: One of the features of a sovereign state is that it

options.A: has the capacity to defend itself from external aggression
options.B: has a large number of soldiers
options.C: practices the presidential system of government
options.D: is not indebted to other countries

records.year_provenance: Dated older source, full question recovery
records.source_excerpt:
19. One of the features of a sovereign state is that it
A. has the capacity to defend itself from
external aggression
B. has a large number of soldiers
C. practices the presidential system of government
D.  is not indebted to other countries
records.hold_reason: Sovereignty means supreme authority and external independence, not guaranteed military capacity. A state can remain sovereign while relying on another state for defence, and the other options are not defining features either.
